Summary: [FR-05] Supplier feedback accepts exceeding deliverable quantity
Description: Entering deliverable quantity 50 (or -5) on a 5-unit order is accepted without boundary validation.
Environment: Viper SCM v1.0.0 (Baseline Frozen Build • Node 24 / React 18 SPA)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Navigate to Supply Requests in Supplier Portal.
2. On request REQ-2026-001 (5 units required), click Send Feedback.
3. In Deliverable Quantity, enter 50 (or -5).
4. Click Submit Supplier Response.
Expected Result: System rejects submission with error toast ('Deliverable quantity cannot exceed requested quantity (5 units) or be less than 1') and refuses to persist invalid record.
Actual Result: System accepts submission without boundary check, persists deliverable quantity 50 to viper_feedbacks, and marks request as In-Review.

Summary: [FR-06] Notification dispatch blocked on unassigned request edit
Description: Editing priority on an unassigned order halts the notification pipeline because supplierId is null.
Environment: Viper SCM v1.0.0 (Baseline Frozen Build • React 18 SPA)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Navigate to Manage Requests in Coordinator Portal.
2. Locate unassigned request REQ-2026-003 and click Edit.
3. Modify Priority from Medium to High.
4. Click Update & Dispatch Alert.
5. Inspect notification records and recipient inbox.
Expected Result: System handles unassigned supplier gracefully by prompting for assignment or dispatching update event to general coordinator log.
Actual Result: Notification creation is blocked because supplierId foreign key is null. Notification is skipped entirely and no alert is delivered.
